Configuring the build pipeline

The pipeline reads its settings from a single file in the project root.

pipeline.config.json

Set outDir to change where files are written, and minify to control compression.

// pipeline.config.json
{ "outDir": "dist", "minify": true }
pipeline.config.json
{ "watch": false }

Environment variables

VariablePurpose
BUILD_TARGETSelects the platform to build for
CIDisables interactive prompts when set
  • --watch
  • --verbose prints every step
$ pipeline build --verbose
Build finished in 2.1s
